name: Siren
description: A creature type of humanoid sea creatures, typically female and winged, who lure mariners to destruction with seductive singing.

description_citations.text: "Siren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sirens of Ixalan are described as mercurial creatures who serve on Brazen Coalition crews, in at least one case as captain.
timeline.quote: They are mercurial creatures who can turn in an instant from loving to murderous

citation.text: "Siren", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Ixalan, a ship's carpenter adds a cosmium gem to a siren figurehead, animating it into an artificial flying siren.
timeline.quote: a ship's carpenter added a cosmium gem to their siren figurehead, which animated it into an artificial flying siren

citation.text: "Siren", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Malcolm is a male siren of Ixalan.
relations.quote: Uniquely, several sirens are male, the most notable being Malcolm
